text:
A pure liquid is left in an open beaker and some of the liquid molecules escape by evaporation.
Which statement about this process is correct?
A
None of the escaping molecules return to the liquid.
B
The escaping molecules are generally the more energetic ones.
C
The rate of escape of the molecules can be increased by increasing the depth of the liquid in
the beaker.
D
The temperature of the remaining liquid is unaffected by the escape of the molecules.

options.label: A
options.text: None of the escaping molecules return to the liquid.

options.label: B
options.text: The escaping molecules are generally the more energetic ones.
